metadata.description: Multi-model dispatch plugins for Claude Code: Antigravity (agy), Codex parallel fan-out (cx), and explicit per-task routing (dispatch).

plugins.name: agy
plugins.description: Use Antigravity (agy CLI) from Claude Code: setup checks, task delegation, status, model probe, and parallel fan-out.

plugins.name: cx
plugins.description: Extras around the codex plugin: parallel fan-out via codex-rescue.

plugins.name: dispatch
plugins.description: Explicit per-task agent routing: user picks the dispatch target per task, then fan out in parallel.
